'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).

Typed printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
